svg.title: Video Scale S1 BPM workflow — Micro Production
svg.desc: Seven-phase governed video production BPM workflow for Micro Production. It shows greenlight, pre-production, production, post, release review, distribution, post-launch learning, quality gates, typed artifacts, principal agents, targeted rework, and fail-closed runtime status.
svg.metadata: Generated from spec/production_scale_framework.md. Visual system follows ui/public/svg/video.workflow.svg. Evidence basis: Explicit S1 data flow and crew capability map from the production scale framework. Runtime remains fail-closed; capability maps do not activate tools, network, or production.

g.text: Video Scale S1 · Micro Production BPM Workflow
Shared seven-phase production skeleton · specialized tasks, crew, gates, handoffs and feedback
FAIL-CLOSED — This workflow is a capability/scheduling design. It does not activate network, tools, providers or production without separate host and human gates.
Scale is selected before archetype. Typed handoffs carry correlation, evidence, quality, rights and HiTL state.
Optimize speed and cost for short-form content with a small
crew, minimal branching and one primary outlet. Social spike,
single-SKU promo, fail-closed proof of concept, or A/B/H DNA
A/B/H defaults; D-light · one DNA graph. Explicit S1 data flow
and crew capability map from the production scale framework.
L1 required; light L2; rare legal-only HiTL; sparse critique;
Host-owned orchestration, evidence, memory and approvals span all seven phases.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Human brief enters through host command/UI.
• Producer checks light budget and rights.
Brief · KPI · light budget/rights · S1 plan
Reduce scope or clear rights before launch.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• L1 is hard; low-risk L2 may be light.
• Keep minimal nodes and no unnecessary branches.
Return failed concept or script only.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Judge/GateKeeper consolidate L1 and light L2.
• Compliance performs a light legal check.
• Human reviews only material legal risk.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Optionally emit a second platform crop.
• Project status to console through host events.
• One branch is the S1 operating rule.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
Use validated signals in the next S1 brief.
HANDOFF CONTRACT — correlation_id · from/to agent · artifact_ref/type · scale · archetype · evidence_refs · L1/L2 · rights_state · needs_hitl
Offline/UAT runs also emit knowledge_usage. Crew lists are capability maps; host policy remains authoritative.
Evidence basis: Explicit S1 data flow and crew capability map from the production scale framework.
Principal unique agents linked in this diagram: 27 · Seven phases · fail-closed runtime · no automatic scale promotion.
